productDirection.summary: Canvas Fogworks is both a general visual/pixel editor and a game-authoring environment.

items.summary: Continue extracting cohesive panels and workflows from App.tsx; project files, image-sequence import, workspace/runtime controls and the 3D inspector are tested seams.
Extend the delivered named-clip controllers with native glTF animation import, 3D transform tracks and skeletal skinning; add crossfades and component-instance playback with explicit tests.
Map runtime events and typed triggers to undo-safe authoring commands and sandboxed gameplay scripts.
Create and smoke-test a standalone game export path distinct from packaging the Canvas Fogworks editor.
Add measured production physics fidelity: rotated colliders, slopes, restitution and a replaceable backend boundary.
Define persisted audio assets and reachable authoring/runtime playback without coupling audio state to document history each frame.
Decide whether SVG and Canvas need WebGL-equivalent per-fragment mesh-relief normals and self-occlusion; flat-surface scene lighting is now shared.
Implement minmax/fit-content tracks and remaining explicit grid-placement refinements.
Restore incremental dirty-state reuse for documents containing component instances.
Defer AI, full plugins and collaboration until production-hardening work is established.
